- HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-0003 · SHOULD — Use progressive immersion to blend your custom environment with a person’s surroundings · Immersive experiences > Immersion and passthrough > Immersion styles ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/immersive-experiences))
- HIG-FOUNDATIONS-IMMERSIVE-EXPERIENCES-0004 · SHOULD — Use full immersion to create a fully immersive experience · Immersive experiences > Immersion and passthrough > Immersion styles ([source](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/immersive-experiences))
